errors.evidence: In the SMD dataset, the purple bar (w/o feature embedding) is at approximately 89%, which is visibly lower than the peach bar (w/o skip embedding) at approximately 90%. Stating that both are "about 90%" incorrectly equates their values and misses their relative ordering.

In the SWaT dataset, the purple bar (w/o feature embedding) is at approximately 85.5%, which is visibly lower than the peach bar (w/o skip embedding) at approximately 86%. Stating that both are "about 86%" incorrectly equates their values.

In the SMAP dataset, the purple bar (w/o feature embedding) at approximately 90% is visibly higher than the peach bar (w/o skip embedding) at approximately 89.8%. Stating that both are "about 90%" incorrectly equates their values and misses their relative ordering.

In the MSL dataset, the purple bar (at ~89%) is visibly higher than the peach bar (at ~88.5%). The description gives an incorrect range for the purple bar and overestimates the value for the peach bar, thereby obscuring the true relationship between their values.
